tasks.title: Physically qualify the x8664 Win32/GDI + ConPTY host on Windows 10/11. The source tranche now...
tasks.group: Backlog · NCT-123 Experimental Windows host - partial
tasks.description: Physically qualify the x8664 Win32/GDI + ConPTY host on Windows 10/11. The source tranche now cross-compiles without GTK, owns bounded tabs/splits and per-pane ConPTY/VT state, supports native selection and DEC mouse reporting, ships the separate native NoctEd editor, and produces a reproducible per-user NSIS installer with reversible shortcuts/Open-With registration and an operator-owned signing hook. Wine-hosted self-tests and installer lifecycle smoke pass, but Wine does not prove physical ConPTY/GDI, input, installer, or editor behavior on supported Windows releases. Source: BACKLOG.md § NCT-123 Experimental Windows host - partial:28
